fields.summary_ko.0: TSMC (NYSE: TSM) stock surged 14.5% on news of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's return, with Nvidia representing its largest customer accounting for 19% of 2025 revenue.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSMC is world's largest semiconductor manufacturer with high-performance computing representing 68% of revenue, with AI data center chip business as key growth driver.
fields.summary_ko.2: TSMC's current 23.6x P/E ratio is reasonable, with Nvidia requesting review of 3D memory chip manufacturing creating potential new business opportunities.
